title: Saltglass Cavern: The Diplomat's Resonance Tablet
premise: In a crystalline underworld cut by migratory subterranean rivers, the diplomat must negotiate a route across a disputed threshold using a sealed bilingual accord.
ending: Recover the Resonance Tablet and return with the mutual passage covenant; Cavern Chorus can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive shard bloom while evading the mineral sentinel without sacrificing the mutual passage covenant.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Cavern Chorus to witness the sealed bilingual accord.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to reveal the faction's old promise
